svg.text: Two shapes, two diagnoses, two different repairs
Both curves plateau high, and together

text.tspan: More data will not move either curve.

svg.text: Repair: more features, higher degree, weaker penalty.
A gap that does not close
still open at the last point

text.tspan: More data would help, and is not on offer.

svg.text: Repair: shrink the model — ridge, lasso, early stopping.
